recipes.description: Take care not to burn the carrots at the end of this recipe. They should be browned (but not blackened) for a tasty side dish.
steps: Peel the carrots.
Cut in half lengthwise, then cut into 1 inch pieces.
Melt the margarine in a heavy saucepan on low heat. Add the carrots.
Stir to coat them with the margarine.
Add the water, salt, and pepper.
Cover and simmer for about 15 minutes until tender. Drain the water. Add the sugar. Cover the pan.
Shake the pan back and forth on the burner for 1 minute.
Cook for 1 more minute, until the carrots are glazed but not brown.

recipes.name: Sweet Acorn Squash
recipes.description: Squash baked in the oven and then seasoned with cinnamon and nutmeg give this dish a taste of fall.
steps: Put each squash in the microwave.
Heat for 1 1/2 minutes on high. This will soften the squash and make it easier to cut. Cut each squash in half.
Remove the seeds and loosen fibers in the middle.
Place the squash on an ungreased baking pan.
The cut side of the squash should be face-up, and the uncut part of the squash should touch the pan.
Pour 2 tablespoons of juice into each half of the squash.
Spread it evenly on the inside of each squash.
Bake at 400 degrees F for 30 to 45 minutes, until tender.
Season with cinnamon and nutmeg and serve.

recipes.name: Honey Milk Balls
recipes.description: Honey milk balls make a great afternoon snack – packed with protein and calcium. They taste like a treat, so be sure to save a few for yourself.
steps: Mix honey and peanut butter.
Gradually add dry milk and mix well. Chill for easier handling.
With greased hands, form into small balls.
Roll in crushed cereal flakes. Chill until firm.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.name: Green Bean and Rice Casserole
recipes.description: This no-fuss side dish is a great addition to any meal and can be prepared in a flash.
ingredients: 1 can reduced-sodium green beans, drained (about 15 ounces)
1 can diced tomatoes, no salt added (about 15 ounces)
steps: In a medium-sized pan, cook onions in vegetable oil until they start to turn light brown.
Add the rice, green beans, tomatoes, and water. Bring to a boil.
Cover the pot with a lid and cook over low heat for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Snappy Cole Slaw
recipes.description: Make this coleslaw in a snap. This tasty coleslaw can be doubled easily and made a day in advance to let the flavors blend.
steps: Wash and shred the cabbage with a knife or grater. Put in a mixing bowl.
Bring the vinegar and water to a boil in the saucepan.
Remove from heat and add the sugar, mustard, and black pepper to the saucepan.
Continue to cook this mixture in the saucepan until the sugar is dissolved and hot, then pour over the shredded cabbage. Toss.
Refrigerate until chilled to blend flavors.

recipes.name: Chimichurri Sauce
recipes.description: Add some South American flair to your meal with this flavorful sauce, which can be used on meat, fish, or vegetables as a marinade or poured over your finished product.
ingredients: 1 cup flat-leaf parsley, lightly packed and chopped without the stalks
steps: Place all the ingredients in a blender or food processor and pulse until well chopped, but not pureed.
Spoon the sauce over grilled meats, poultry, seafood, or vegetables. This sauce can also be used as a marinade.

recipes.name: Roasted Herb Potatoes
recipes.description: Rosemary adds a delicious flavor and aroma to these potatoes. Enjoy your herb roasted potatoes as a side to your favorite protein food entrée.
ingredients: 1 pound potatoes (3 medium or 3 cups cubed)
2 teaspoons vegetable oil (or cooking oil of choice)
steps: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F. Coat a baking sheet with vegetable cooking spray. Wash and peel the potatoes.
Cut the potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes, and put them in a large bowl.
Put the oil, rosemary, and salt in a small bowl. Stir together.
Pour the oil mix over the potatoes.
Stir to coat the potatoes evenly.
Spread the potatoes on the baking sheet.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until lightly browned.

recipes.name: Watermelon Gazpacho
recipes.description: Watermelon can be combined with a savory ingredients for a surprising and refreshing twist in this simple and quick gazpacho recipe.
steps: In a small bowl, mix 1 cup of cubed watermelon and 1/2 of chopped cucumber; set aside.
Process remaining ingredients in a food processor or blender until puréed.
Transfer all ingredients to a large bowl and stir.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.name: Roasted Cauliflower
recipes.description: Oven-roasted cauliflower sprinkled with cheese is a simple and delicious side dish that pairs well with any entrée.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil (or cooking oil of choice)
steps: Remove outer leaves of cauliflower. Cut florets off the stem. Wash and drain.
Combine oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Toss the cauliflower florets in the oil mixture.
Spread cauliflower on a large rimmed baking sheet.
Roast in the oven at 450 degrees F for 15 to 20 minutes until the cauliflower starts to soften and begins to brown. Sprinkle with cheese.
Continue to roast for 5 to 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Waldorf Salad
recipes.description: Extra apples from the market? Try this Waldorf Salad with walnuts and crunchy fall apples.
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Place chopped walnuts on a baking sheet and bake for 12 to 15 minutes.
Stir occasionally until they are evenly toasted.
Combine nuts, apples, celery, and raisins.
Stir together yogurt, sugar, and lemon juice.
Pour over apple mixture and toss lightly.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.name: Summer Italian Vegetables
recipes.description: Fresh tomatoes, summer squash, green peppers, and onions give this cheesy side dish a boost to any summer meal. Use any vegetables that you have on hand or find at the Farmers Market.
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Combine onion, squash, tomato, and green pepper in a baking dish. Sprinkle with oregano.
Pour the tomato sauce over the vegetables.
Bake, uncovered at 350 degrees F for 20 to 30 minutes.
Top with cheese and bake another 4 to 5 minutes until cheese is melted. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.name: Homemade Mashed Potatoes
recipes.description: A creamy comfort food that is quick and easy to prepare!
steps: Peel the potatoes, and cut them into chunks.
Put the potatoes in a medium saucepan with enough water to cover them.
Cook the potatoes on medium heat for 15 minutes or until tender.
Remove the potatoes from the heat.
Drain the water off the potatoes.
Mash the potatoes with a fork or potato masher.
Stir in enough milk to make the potatoes smooth and creamy.
Add the butter, salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Corn Salad with Fresh Basil and Lemon
recipes.description: This is a great way to use fresh corn when it's in season. Make it the night before your next BBQ or family gathering.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil (or cooking oil of choice)
1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil (or 1 tsp dried basil)
steps: Cook corn in boiling water or in the microwave. Cut corn from the cob. Add onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice and sugar. Add oil and combine.
Stir the oil/lemon mixture and basil. And salt and pepper to taste (optional).
Refrigerate at least 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Louisiana Green Beans
recipes.description: Jazz up canned green beans with peppers, onions, and tomatoes!
ingredients: 2 cans (14.5 ounces each) low-sodium green beans, drained
steps: Peel and chop the onion.
Chop the green pepper and celery.
Drain the liquid from the green beans. Rinse with water.
Put the green beans in a saucepan.
Add enough water to cover them Cook the green beans on low heat until tender. Then drain off the water.
Combine all the ingredients in a skillet.
Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes, until the celery is tender and the food is hot.

recipes.name: Magical Fruit Salad
recipes.description: The whole family will love making this as much as they love eating it! Pineapple, grapes, and bananas add flavor and texture to this creamy and delicious dessert.
ingredients: 1 can (20 ounces) pineapple chunks, juice packed
1 cup seedless grapes, red or green
1 package (3.5 ounces) instant pudding mix, lemon or vanilla
steps: Drain off the juice from the canned pineapples. Put chunks in a large bowl. Rinse the grapes and drain. Add the grapes to the bowl.
Peel the bananas and cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl. Pour the milk over the fruit.
While slowly stirring the fruit mixture, sprinkle in the pudding mix.
Let the mixture stand for 5 minutes and serve.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.name: Caramel Sauce
recipes.description: Serve this sauce over fruit or frozen yogurt for a dessert or special snack.
ingredients: 8 1/3 tablespoons nonfat dry milk (1/2 cup + 1 teaspoon)
steps: Reconstitute non-fat dried milk with water.
Combine reconstituted milk and cornstarch in a small saucepan and mix until cornstarch is thoroughly dissolved.
Add the butter and brown sugar and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly with a wire whisk until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Continue to boil 1 minute.
Remove pan from heat and stir in vanilla.
Serve warm over baked French toast, ice cream, or fruit.

recipes.name: Frozen Pear Pops
recipes.description: These frozen pear pops are a refreshing treat! Sweet pears mixed with orange juice and yogurt is a snack that is sure to please.
ingredients: 6 ounces frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
ice cube tray or small paper cups
steps: Cut canned pears into small pieces.
Add yogurt and orange juice to cut pears and mix well to combine.
Divide into 8 ice cubes squares (or 4 small paper cups).
Place in cut straws or popsicle sticks. Freeze and enjoy!

recipes.name: Gazpacho Soup
recipes.description: This yummy chilled tomato soup makes a great addition to lunch or dinner.
steps: Chop the tomato, cucumber, and peppers into very small pieces.
Put all the ingredients in a large glass or plastic bowl.
Stir well with a wooden or plastic spoon.
Chill in the fridge for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

recipes.name: Apple-Stuffed Squash
recipes.description: All you need is a microwave to cook this delicious and seasonal side dish.
steps: Cut squash into halves and remove seeds.
Place in a glass dish, cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 5 minutes.
Melt butter in a separate bowl in the microwave.
Mix in apples, sugar, and cinnamon. Microwave for 1 1/2 minutes.
Spoon apple filling into each squash half.
Cover and microwave on high for 3-5 minutes until squash and apples are tender. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Pea Guacamole
recipes.description: While avocados tend to get all the guacamole glory, sometimes they’re not available, not ripe, or just too expensive! Check out this tasty, bright, and satisfying recipe that put the humble green pea in the leading role.
ingredients: 1 can (4 ounces) diced green chilies, drained
steps: Mash peas until smooth.
Add the lime juice, tomato, onion, green chilies, cilantro, garlic, salt (if using), and black pepper. Mix well.
Serve with an assortment of raw vegetables and whole-grain tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Greek Salad
recipes.description: While feta cheese is the star of any Greek salad, this recipe contains all of the must-have ingredients for a classic salad that is sure to please.
ingredients: 6 romaine lettuces leaves, torn into 1 1/2-inch pieces (Or more if desired)
1 medium tomato, chopped (Can also use cherry tomatoes)
2 tablespoons olive oil (or oil of choice)
steps: Combine lettuce, cucumber, tomato, onion, and cheese in large serving bowl.
Whisk together oil, lemon juice, oregano, and salt in small bowl.
Pour over lettuce mixture; toss until coated. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Lentil Stew
recipes.description: Lentils, carrots, and tomatoes are a savory and satisfying combination in this delicious and easy to prepare stew. Enjoy with a side of your favorite citrus fruit.
ingredients: 3 cans diced tomatoes, low-sodium (14.5 ounces each)
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add chopped onion.
Cook for 3 minutes, or until tender.
Stir in garlic powder, carrots, lentils, tomatoes, water, and chili powder.
Simmer, uncovered, for about 20 minutes or until lentils are tender.

recipes.name: Salata Ma Jibna (Salad with Parmesan Cheese)
recipes.description: Onions, carrots, and cabbage give this dish a crunchy and crisp texture. Lemon juice and vinegar give the veggies a tangy flavor. Enjoy along side of your favorite entrée.
ingredients: 1 cup onions, cut into slivers or thin slices
1 cup cabbage, cut into slivers or thin slices
1/2 cup carrots, cut into very thin slices
steps: In a salad bowl, combine onions, cabbage, carrots, and tomatoes.
Toss with olive oil, lemon juice, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Sprinkle garlic and Parmesan over salad.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Chocolate Muffins
recipes.description: This dense, moist chocolate muffin contains no fats or oils. The secret ingredient is canned (or puréed) pumpkin that binds the ingredients together for a tasty, satisfying treat.
steps: Whisk all the dry ingredients together. Add pumpkin and water.
Fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients until just combined. Fold in chocolate chips.
Place batter into 24 prepared muffin tins and bake at 350 °F for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.name: Butterfly Bite
recipes.description: Designed with kids in mind, this recipe puts a new spin on snack time. Try different vegetables or dried fruit for a different looking "butterfly."
steps: Clean celery with vegetable brush under cool running water.
Cut celery in half cross wise.
Fill center of each celery stick with one tablespoon of peanut butter. This is the body of the butterfly Add two pretzels to form the butterfly’s wings.
Use extra pretzel pieces for antenna and raisins for decoration.

recipes.name: Celery with Apricot Blue Cheese Spread
recipes.description: Crunchy, sweet celery is a versatile snack food, just right for this flavorful spread. Filled with dried fruit and nuts, this enticing and quick low-fat spread can be made ahead or on the spot. You could also serve it on whole grain crackers as an appetizer.
steps: Chop dried fruit and pecans.
Mix blue cheese, cream cheese, and yogurt with a fork or hand mixer until smooth.
Stir in chopped, dried fruit and pecans.
Refrigerate spread until ready for use.
Slice celery stalks into 3-4 inch sticks.
Fill celery pieces with spread.

recipes.name: Roasted Chickpeas (Garbanzo Beans)
recipes.description: These crunchy chickpeas make a great on-the-go snack or a healthy topping to your favorite salad. Experiment with different spices to see which ones you like best.
ingredients: 1 can (15 ounces) low-sodium garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed
1 tablespoon canola oil (or cooking oil of choice)
spices of your choice, optional (try garlic, paprika, sage, etc.)
steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Drain and rinse the beans until there is no foamy residue.
Pick out the skins and discard.
Wrap the drained beans in a clean towel to dry thoroughly.
Measure oil into a 9x13-inch baking dish or foil lined pan.
Pour beans into dish, sprinkle with salt and spices.
Mix oil and spices well to coat all the beans.
Bake for 45 to 60 minutes, stirring or shaking every 15 minutes.
Longer makes more crunch, but watch to prevent burning!

recipes.name: Zucchini And Tomatoes
recipes.description: Spend less time cooking and more time enjoying your summer with this fast and delicious summer veggie side dish. Pairs well with grilled meat, fish, or tofu.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter (or cooking oil of your choice)
2 tomatoes (peeled and diced, or a 16 ounce can of diced tomatoes, drained)
steps: Melt butter or oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and garlic.
Cook until tender, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Add zucchini, tomatoes, and seasonings.
Cover pan, reduce heat, and cook until vegetables are tender.

recipes.name: Zucchini Au Gratin
recipes.description: A fast and delicious way to prepare the zucchini or yellow squash flooding your garden or market this summer.
steps: Wash and slice vegetables.
Place zucchini, onion, water, margarine, and pepper in a frying pan.
Cover and cook over medium heat for one minute.
Remove cover and cook until crisp-tender, about 10 minutes.
Turn with large spoon to cook evenly.
Sprinkle with cheese; toss lightly. Serve at once.

recipes.name: Banana Pudding
recipes.description: Dress up instant pudding mix with this dessert that combines low fat dairy and fruit for a tasty, nourishing treat.
ingredients: 1 (3.4 ounce) box instant pudding mix, banana or vanilla
1 (8 ounce) container of fat-free plain yogurt (or non-dairy whipped topping)
2 medium bananas, sliced (or other sliced fruit)
steps: In a medium bowl, combine pudding and milk.
Beat with wooden spoon, wire whisk, or electric mixer on lowest speed for 2 minutes Gently mix yogurt (or whipped topping) with pudding mixture. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Layer fruit slices in the bottom of 8 dessert cups.
Pour the pudding mixture over sliced fruit. Top with more fruit.
Refrigerate until ready to serve, at least 5 minutes.
The taste is better if it's refrigerated longer.

recipes.name: Dutch Green Beans
recipes.description: Using canned green beans and other pantry items, this side dish is great when you don't have much time. Adding the onion at the end kicks up the flavor a bit.
steps: Drain the beans, and save the liquid from the can in small bowl.
Pour 1/2 cup bean liquid into the saucepan.
Add the cornstarch in the bean liquid. Stir well.
Add the vinegar and brown sugar.
Put on medium heat and bring to a boil. Turn the heat to low.
Add the green beans and onions. Heat and serve.

recipes.name: Pancakes (from Better Baking Mix)
recipes.description: Using a pre-made baking mix -- like our Better Baking Mix -- is a great shortcut to making homemade pancakes!
steps: Put all the ingredients in a bowl.
Stir just enough to moisten dry ingredients.
Preheat skillet on medium-high heat.
The skillet is ready when drops of water "dance" on the dry surface.
Add a teaspoon of vegetable oil or use cooking oil spray.
For each pancake, pour 3 to 4 tablespoons of batter onto hot skillet.
Cook slowly until the surface is covered with bubbles.
Turn and cook until second side is lightly browned.

recipes.name: Simmered Beans
recipes.description: Savory simmered beans are simple and satisfying. Enjoy as a side to your favorite entrée.
ingredients: 2 cups dried beans, rinsed (pinto, black, or pink)
steps: Place beans, water, onion, and bay leaf in a large pot.
Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low.
Simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until beans are tender.
Remove bay leaf and stir in salt. Cook 15 minutes longer.
Top each serving of simmered beans with 1/2 cup fresh salsa, or store beans in refrigerator for up to 3 days in a covered plastic or glass container.

recipes.name: Honey Glazed Turnips
recipes.description: Cook turnips and honey on the stove to create an easy and healthy side dish for dinner.
ingredients: 3 turnips, medium, about 1 1/2 pounds (sliced or cubed)
steps: Peel turnips.
Slice or cube turnips, 1/2 inch pieces.
In a medium saucepan, combine honey, canola oil and water and bring to a boil.
Add turnips, salt and black pepper, cover and bring to a boil.
Reduce to simmer and cook for about 10 minutes.
Uncover and continue to cook until turnips are golden and glazed, about 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Turkey Gravy
recipes.description: This gravy uses chicken or turkey broth to create an easy and fast gravy. Perfect for a big holiday meal.
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chicken or turkey broth, low-sodium
2 1/2 ounces giblets (cooked and chopped, approximately 1/2 cup)
steps: Melt margarine in skillet over low heat. Mix in flour and salt. Stir and heat until bubbly.
Add broth slowly, stirring constantly.
Cook over low heat for 5 to 10 minutes. Add the cooked giblets.
Heat a few minutes to blend flavors.
Store leftovers in refrigerator within 2 hours.

recipes.name: Potato Cakes
recipes.description: Enjoy these potato cakes with fat-free sour cream or fat-free yogurt and chives.
ingredients: 2 cups potatoes (cold, mashed, made from instant potato flakes)
steps: Prepare potatoes according to package.
Put mashed potatoes into a bowl. Add flour and onion. Mix well.
Pat potato mixture on a lightly floured board until 1/2 inch thick.
Cut with a 3-inch round cutter.
Place on a baking sheet, cover and refrigerate until just before cooking.
Heat oil in a frying pan or griddle.
Fry cakes over medium heat, turning to brown on both sides. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Oven Baked Sweet Potato Fries
recipes.description: Sweet potato fries are a quick and delicious way to add flavor and color to your dinner plate.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil (or cooking oil of choice)
steps: Wash and peel sweet potatoes. Cut into 1/4-inch slices.
In a large bowl, toss slices in olive oil until coated.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper if desired.
Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Bake at 425 degrees F until tender and golden brown (about 20 minutes), turning occasionally to brown evenly.

recipes.name: Apple Salad with Sweet & Tangy Yogurt Dressing
recipes.description: Crisp, light, and refreshing, this salad combines apples, celery, carrots, raisins, and a yogurt dressing.
steps: Wash apples, celery, and carrots before dicing/grating. Toss apples with lemon juice.
Add celery, carrots and raisins.
Fold yogurt into apple mixture. Cover.
Chill for at least 1 hour before serving. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.name: Panned Cabbage
recipes.description: A quick, delicious, cruciferous delight. Try this recipe with green or purple cabbage, or a mixture of the two.
steps: Melt butter or margarine in a heavy saucepan or skillet.
Add cabbage and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add water.
Cover pan with a tight-fitting lid to hold in steam.
Cook over low heat until cabbage is tender (6 to 8 minutes), stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Add lemon juice and serve.

recipes.name: Italian Inspired Summer Squash
recipes.description: Fresh sweet basil and cheese give summer squash a burst of flavor.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil (or cooking oil of choice), divided
6 tablespoons Parmesan cheese or Romano cheese, grated
steps: Using a large, oven-proof frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil on medium-high.
Arrange squash in pan, add water, and season lightly with salt, pepper, if using, and basil.
Cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, or until tender crisp.
Sprinkle with cheese and drizzle with remaining oil.
Place under a preheated broiler and broil until cheese melts and browns slightly.

recipes.name: Mashed Sweet Potatoes
recipes.description: Mashed sweet potatoes are an easy and nutritious side dish that can accompany any entrée. A great idea to try in place of traditional mashed potatoes.
steps: Wash and peel the potatoes.
Cut them into slices that are 3/4 inch thick.
Put them in a saucepan with enough water to cover the potatoes.
Bring the water to a boil on medium heat.
Cook the potatoes for 20 to 25 minutes until they’re soft. Drain the water.
Put the potatoes in a medium bowl.
Use a fork or potato masher to mash the potatoes.
Mix in the thyme, salt, and pepper.

recipes.name: Layered Black Bean Dip
recipes.description: Looking for a healthy snack for game day? This Layered Black Bean Dip is colorful, wholesome, and tasty. Kids in the kitchen can help with the mashing, mixing, and layering. Paired with veggie sticks or baked whole wheat tortilla chips, this is recipe is a winner!
ingredients: 1 can black beans, low-sodium (15 ounce, drained and rinsed)
steps: Mash beans and mix with onion powder, dried oregano, garlic powder, and cayenne pepper. Spread on a serving dish.
Top with salsa, sour cream, green onions, and grated cheese.

recipes.name: Zucchini Coleslaw
recipes.description: This colorful dish is a delicious alternative to the sweet coleslaw and a great way to eat your veggies.
steps: Drain zucchini by pressing between layers of paper towels.
Put zucchini in large bowl; add cabbage, carrots, onions, and radishes.
In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients.
Pour over vegetables and toss well.
Cover and chill at least one hour.

recipes.name: Fruit Slush
recipes.description: Serve this fruit slush as a drink or a dessert, and keep leftovers in the fridge for later. Pour it over fresh ice when you are ready to eat.
ingredients: 3 cups cantaloupe or watermelon, coarsely chopped, seeded, peeled
steps: In a blender, puree fruit and lime juice until smooth. Add sugar if desired.
Combine fruit mixture and water in a large pitcher.
To eliminate the pulp pour through a strainer (optional).
Cover and refrigerate for up to a week.
To serve, stir well and pour into tall glasses over ice.

recipes.name: Vegetable Pinwheels
recipes.description: Have kids help mix the ingredients and spread the cream cheese mixture on the tortillas for this fun and flavorful snack.
steps: Drain the corn and green chilis.
Collect, chop, and measure all ingredients before starting to prepare the recipe.
Mix cream cheese, corn, green chilies, onions, and salsa together in a bowl.
Spread mixture on tortillas, roll up tightly, and wrap in plastic wrap.
Cut in 1-inch slices, and serve immediately, or store in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

recipes.name: Bean Dip
recipes.description: Serve this easy-to-make bean and cheese dip at a party or as an after-school snack at home.
steps: Drain the kidney beans, but save the liquid in a small bowl Place the beans, vinegar, chili powder, and cumin in a blender. Blend until smooth.
Add enough saved bean liquid to make the dip easy to spread.
Stir in the chopped onion and grated cheese.
Store in a tightly covered container and place in the fridge Serve with raw vegetable sticks or crackers.

recipes.name: Tropical Morning Treat
recipes.description: Enjoy this tasty fruit dish in the morning or as a snack anytime of the day.
steps: Place orange juice in bowl. Wash apple and dry. Remove the seeds and dice.
Coat apple surfaces with orange juice to prevent browning.
Peel orange and break into sections.
Cut sections into small pieces.
Peel and slice banana into 1/4 inch circles.
Combine all fruit and orange juice lightly in a bowl and mix together. Chill or serve immediately.

recipes.name: Broiled Tomatoes and Cheese
recipes.description: This recipe is especially tasty when using tomatoes that are fresh from the garden or farmers market.
ingredients: 2 sprays of cooking spray (or vegetable oil)
steps: Wash tomatoes and cut in half.
Mix cottage cheese, basil, and pepper.
Spread cheese on tomato halves.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs and spray with cooking spray.
Spray broiler pan with cooking spray.
Place prepared tomatoes on a pan and broil about 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Garden Orchard Salad
recipes.description: Fresh veggies, peanuts, and apples give this crunchy salad a refreshing flavor, and it is coated with non-fat vanilla yogurt for creaminess.
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple (chopped, cored and diced, not peeled)
steps: Wash your hands with soap and water.
Mix all ingredients together in a serving bowl.
Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or longer to allow flavors to blend. Serve cold.
Cover and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.name: Homemade Ranch Dressing
recipes.description: What’s better than ranch dressing? Fresh, homemade ranch dressing! It’s the perfect addition to your salad, veggies, or just about anything you can dip!
steps: Collect and measure all ingredients before starting to prepare the recipe.
Add the dried onion, salt, garlic powder, and dried parsley to a bowl, and stir gently to combine.
Add the Greek yogurt and buttermilk, and stir until spices are evenly distributed. Chill before serving.
Keep leftovers refrigerated, and eat within 1 week.

recipes.name: Baked Cauliflower Tots
recipes.description: The cheesy flavor makes this riced cauliflower feel very indulgent.
ingredients: 2 cups grated or finely chopped cauliflower rice (about half a medium head)
steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F. Lightly grease a baking sheet.
In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well.
Press mixture together to make about 15 small balls or logs and put them on the baking sheet with space between each one.
Bake for 20 minutes or until cooked through.
For extra crispy tots, broil for an extra 2 minutes.
Watch closely to avoid burning.

recipes.name: Somali Summer Salad
recipes.description: A delicious summer salad to serve when summer vegetables are at their peak. Great with grilled meat, fish, and tofu.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil (or oil of your choice)
steps: In a large bowl, combine oil and lemon juice.
Dice all the fruits and vegetables and then add to the bowl.
Add salt and pepper to taste (optional). Serve chilled. Best served within 24 hours.

recipes.name: Rainbow Veggie Salad
recipes.description: This easy and colorful salad tastes best after marinating it overnight. Enjoy it as a side dish at lunch or dinner.
ingredients: 1 can (15.5 ounces) red kidney beans, low-sodium (drained and rinsed)
1 can (15.5 ounces) black beans, low-sodium (drained and rinsed)
steps: Mix all the vegetables together in a large bowl.
Pour dressing over vegetables. Sprinkle with pepper.
Stir gently, coating all vegetables.
Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours.

recipes.name: Pasta Vegetable Salad
recipes.description: Try this tasty salad with whole grain pasta in your favorite shape. Enjoy with family and friends at your next gathering.
steps: Wash your hands with soap and water.
Mix all ingredients in a medium-sized bowl.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Mix again before serving. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.name: Sautéed Beet Greens
recipes.description: Don’t throw away your beet greens! The leafy tops of beets can be so tasty. In this recipe, lemon juice, vegetable oil, and seasonings give them a bold flavor profile.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil (or cooking oil of choice)
4 cups chopped beet greens (2 bunches with stems removed)
2 cloves garlic, minced (or 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder)
steps: Heat oil in a medium-sized pan over medium heat.
Add the beet greens and garlic to the pan.
Stir until just wilted, then reduce the heat to low and stir occasionally until soft, about 5 to 8 minutes.
Stir in lemon juice, red pepper flakes, and salt.
Serve right away or use in another recipe.

recipes.name: Grilled Vegetables
recipes.description: Cooking out tonight? Try cooking vegetables coated in oil and garlic on the grill for a delicious side dish. If you don't have a grill, you can make these vegetables in the oven.
steps: Mix oil and garlic in a large bowl. Add vegetables and toss.
Place vegetable on broiler pan or grill.
Cook 10 minutes, turning twice until vegetables are tender. Place vegetables on platter. Serve.

recipes.name: Creamy Vegetable Dip
recipes.description: Combining yogurt or cottage cheese with savory herbs and spices makes this veggie dip cool and delicious.
ingredients: 2 cups low-fat plain yogurt (or small curd cottage cheese)
steps: In a medium-sized bowl, combine yogurt (or cottage cheese), pepper, garlic powder, dried onion, dried parsley, salt, and dill (if used). Beat until smooth.
Chill dip in refrigerator until ready to serve. Serve with raw vegetables.

recipes.name: Sesame Turnips and Carrots
recipes.description: This quick and easy recipe uses carrots and turnips for a warm, fall flavor. Garlic and honey (or brown sugar) work together to create a sweet and savory blend.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil (or cooking oil of choice)
4 cloves garlic, minced (or 1 teaspoon garlic powder)
steps: In a large skillet on medium-high heat, add oil and sauté turnips, carrots, and salt until vegetables begin to soften.
Stir in garlic and sesame seeds and cook until vegetables begin to brown. Stir in honey. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Cafe Mocha
recipes.description: Jazz up this hot drink by adding cinnamon.
steps: Heat reconstituted non-fat dried milk in saucepan until warm; do not boil.
Add coffee and hot chocolate mix.
Stir well and heat to desired temperature.
Divide coffee mixture between two mugs.
Top with non-fat whipped topping and cinnamon, if desired.

recipes.name: Cantaloupe Cooler
recipes.description: Cool down in the heat with this fruit cooler. Refreshing orange juice mixed with sweet cantaloupe creates the perfect, easy-to-make drink! You can even get creative and use any fruit you please!
steps: Cut melon in half.
Scoop out seeds, remove rind, and discard. Cut melon into 1-inch cubes.
In blender or food processor, blend melon cubes with 1/2 cup orange juice until smooth.
Pour purée into pitcher and stir in the remaining orange juice and the sugar.
Stir until sugar is dissolved.
Pour into glasses filled with crushed ice.

recipes.name: Melon Salsa
recipes.description: Exploding with delicious summer flavors, this salsa recipe is amazing with whatever melon you have on hand.
ingredients: 2 cups fresh melon, seeded and chopped (use one kind or a combination of honeydew, cantaloupe, or watermelon)
1 cup cucumber, peeled, seeded, and chopped
1/4 cup onion, red or white, chopped
fresh cilantro or mint (optional 2 tablespoon, chopped)
1/2 jalapeño, seeded and finely chopped (or hot sauce to taste)
1/4 cup lime juice or lemon juice
steps: In a medium size bowl, stir together all ingredients.
Taste and season with more lemon or lime juice, sugar if needed.
Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes.
Serve with grilled or broiled fish or chicken.

recipes.name: Okra and Greens
recipes.description: Spicy and flavorful, this is an amazing side dish that doubles easily. Double up and enjoy it with a crowd during the summer months when okra is in season.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil (or cooking oil of choice)
4 chili peppers, finely chopped and crushed
steps: In a large heavy pan sauté onions in oil until golden brown.
Add remaining ingredients, except for lemon juice.
Simmer over low heat, covered, until greens are tender.
Squeeze on lemon juice before serving.

recipes.name: Mousse a la Banana
recipes.description: This sweet, creamy, and fruity treat is low in fat and rich in flavor.
steps: Place milk, sugar, vanilla, and banana in blender.
Process 15 seconds at high speed until smooth.
Pour mixture into a small bowl; fold in yogurt. Chill.
Spoon into four dessert dishes; garnish each with two banana slices just before serving.

recipes.name: Swiss Chard and Cranberries
recipes.description: Swiss Chard and Cranberries
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil (or cooking oil of choice)
6 cups swiss chard (1 pound stems chopped and leaves sliced)
steps: In a skillet, heat oil over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until softened.
Add the Swiss chard stems and continue to sauté until beginning to soften.
Increase the heat to high and add the Swiss chard leaves and dried cranberries.
Once the chard is wilted, turn off the heat and cover the skillet, letting it rest for a few minutes before serving.
For softer greens, let them rest a little longer.

recipes.name: Veggie Dip
recipes.description: Cottage cheese is the key to this easy veggie dip. Try with different spices to suit your taste.
steps: Wash your hands with soap and water.
Measure cottage cheese and put in bowl or blender.
Beat with a fork or mixer, or in a blender, until cottage cheese is smooth. Add the other ingredients. Stir together.
Store the dip in the fridge for 1 to 2 hours to let the flavors blend.

recipes.name: Roasted Bell Peppers
recipes.description: Roasting brings out the natural sweetness of the bell peppers. Modify this recipe by trying other seasonings, such as oregano or dried basil.
steps: Preheat oven to 450 degrees F. Wash bell peppers and remove tops and seeds.
Cut peppers in half and rub with vegetable oil.
Place cut side up on a rimmed baking sheet and sprinkle with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Roast until peppers are tender and blistered in spots, about 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Jiffy Oatmeal Crunch
recipes.description: A crunchy and sweet dessert that everyone will love -- and it can be made in minutes! This recipe makes 30 servings, and leftovers freeze well! The quick oats in this recipe add texture and fiber to this delicious dessert.
steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F and grease a 9x13 inch baking pan.
In large skillet, melt butter and brown sugar.
Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients.
Spread into pan and bake for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool; cut into squares.

recipes.name: Garlic Bok Choy
recipes.description: This quick and simple bok choy recipe uses just garlic, salt, and vegetable oil to give bok choy a delicious flavor.
ingredients: 5 cloves garlic (use 4-6 cloves, minced or 1 to 1 1/2 teaspoons of garlic powder)
steps: Cut bok choy crosswise into easy-to-eat pieces.
In a medium skillet over medium-high heat, sauté garlic in oil until fragrant.
If using garlic powder, add with salt in the next step.
Add bok choy and stir quickly. Add salt.
Stir until greens are wilted and stem pieces are tender-crisp. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Muffins (from Better Baking Mix)
recipes.description: Try the original recipe using our Better Baking Mix , or try one of the variations with fruit and spice for a wonderful fresh baked treat.
steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Grease 12-cup muffin pan.
Mix the Better Baking Mix and sugar in a bowl. Beat the egg with a fork.
Add egg, oil, and water to dry ingredients.
Stir just until all ingredients are wet.
Spoon into the prepared muffin pan.

recipes.name: Sautéed Cabbage and Onion
recipes.description: Cabbage, onion, and caraway seeds make this simple and inexpensive side dish a flavorful way to eat more veggies.
steps: Heat oil in a large sauté pan.
Sauté onion over medium heat, until light brown, about 5 to 6 minutes.
Add sliced cabbage, salt, black pepper, and caraway seeds. Stir and cook for 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Summer Salad
recipes.description: This salad can be tossed together, lightening fast. Walnuts give this salad a delightful crunch. Enjoy as a tasty side dish.
steps: Wash your hands with soap and water. Wash and dry greens.
Tear into bite-sized pieces and place in large salad bowl.
Add onion, mushrooms, walnuts, and parsley.
Just before serving, toss with dressing.

recipes.name: Baked Squash with Apples and Spices
recipes.description: What a delicious autumn side dish! Use your favorite varieties of apples and winter squash for this tasty recipe.
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups winter squash (acorn, butternut, or Hubbard)
1 1/2 cups apples (Macintosh, Granny Smith, or Rome)
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Wash and prepare squash and apples (for extra fiber, keep peel on apples).
Cut squash and apples into slices.
Alternate layers of squash and apples in 8x8-inch pan; end with apples.
Sprinkle spices over top layer. Cover with aluminum foil.
Bake in preheated oven for 45 to 60 minutes, until squash is tender.

recipes.name: Cucumber Yogurt and Cream Cheese Dip
recipes.description: Try this cool and tangy low-fat yogurt dip with your favorite vegetables.
ingredients: salt and lemon pepper, to taste (optional)
steps: Stir yogurt and cream cheese until smooth.
Rinse the cucumber under running water.
Slice the cucumber in half the long way and run a spoon down the middle to remove the seeds.
Chop the cucumber into small pieces.
Stir the cucumber, chopped garlic, and seasonings (optional) into the yogurt mixture.

recipes.name: Corn and Bean Medley
recipes.description: Chili powder and pepper flakes give a spicy twist to this classic bean and corn side dish.
steps: Drain the canned corn, but reserve the liquid from the can.
Heat 3 tablespoons of liquid from canned corn in saucepan.
Cook onion in liquid until soft, about 2 minutes.
Add corn, kidney beans, chili powder, and hot red pepper flakes to onion mixture.
Cook over low heat for about 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Pear Party Salsa
recipes.description: Scrumptious, sweet salsa that will be a party favorite. Use a tart apple variety for best results.
ingredients: 1 medium pear, cored and finely chopped
1 medium apple, cored and finely chopped
1 medium orange, peeled and finely chopped
steps: Combine pear, apple, kiwifruit, and orange in a medium-sized bowl.
Pour honey and lemon juice over fruit and gently toss.
Scoop up bites of fruit salsa using bites of cinnamon graham crackers (optional).

recipes.name: Frozen Fruit Cups
recipes.description: Use your own combination of fresh, frozen or canned fruits to create this yummy dessert or snack. It's perfect for a summer day.
ingredients: 1 cup strawberries, frozen, unsweetened (thawed and undrained)
1 cup crushed pineapple, juice packed (undrained, canned)
steps: Line 18 muffin-tin cups with paper baking cups.
Dice or mash bananas and place in a large mixing bowl.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Spoon into muffin-tin cups and freeze at least 3 hours or until firm.
Remove frozen cups and store in a plastic bag in freezer.
Before serving, remove paper cups and let stand 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Banana Cocoa Yogurt Pops
recipes.description: Take a bite out of these creamy yogurt pops! Banana, cocoa, and yogurt are the perfect combo for a frozen treat.
ingredients: mini muffin cups or paper cups
steps: Mash banana with a fork.
Add yogurt to banana and mix well. Stir in cocoa powder.
Divide into 8 mini muffin cups or 4 small paper cups.
Place in cut paper straws or popsicle sticks. Freeze and enjoy!

recipes.name: Lite Fried Okra
recipes.description: Try this healthier version of a soul food favorite.
ingredients: 3/4 teaspoon vegetable oil (or cooking oil of choice)
steps: In a bowl, mix sliced okra, oil, salt, and pepper.
Coat a large fry pan with cooking spray.
Heat over medium heat, and add okra mixture, turning often with a wooden spoon or spatula.
Cook until okra is browned, about 10 minutes.
Serve with hot sauce or favorite relish.

recipes.name: Quick Black-Eyed Peas
recipes.description: Tasty turkey bacon and frozen black-eyed peas are the star ingredients in this recipe. Add a little chipotle pepper and sauce, cayenne pepper, or jalapeños if you prefer some additional heat.
steps: Over medium high heat cook bacon and onions for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the rest of the ingredients and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to simmer and allow to cook until the peas are tender, about 30 minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Spicy Cucumber & Orange Salad
recipes.description: Chili powder and lime juice are the secret ingredients in this cucumber and orange salad.
steps: Wash the cucumbers, oranges and lemon or lime under cold running water. Slice the cucumbers.
Peel and cut the oranges into small pieces.
Place cucumber slices and orange pieces in a medium size bowl.
Add chili powder, lemon or lime juice and salt.

recipes.name: Chilled Cantaloupe Soup
recipes.description: This cool, refreshing melon and citrus soup is perfect for a day when it is too hot to cook. Have it with a hearty, protein-filled sandwich on whole grain bread for a filling meal.
steps: Place cantaloupe and 1/2 cup orange juice in a container of a blender or food processor.
Cover with lid and blend until smooth. Transfer to large bowl.
Stir in lime juice, cinnamon, and remaining orange juice.
Cover, and refrigerate for at least one hour. Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Tuna Salad with Grapes
recipes.description: Grapes make this tuna salad both savory and sweet. Serve this salad over lettuce leaves for a quick and easy lunch.
ingredients: 2 cans water packed tuna (5 ounce cans, drained)
steps: In a medium-sized bowl, combine drained tuna, celery, mayonnaise and yogurt and stir.
Add grapes to mixture and stir gently.
Cover and chill until ready to serve. Serve over lettuce leaves.

recipes.name: Berries with Banana Cream
recipes.description: Make your own "banana cream" with yogurt, banana, and fruit juice. Then, add on top of fresh sliced strawberries for a delicious dessert or snack. Add honey and cinnamon for extra flavor.
steps: Combine yogurt, banana, and juice and mash with a fork until most chunks are gone. Wash and slice strawberries.
Top the berries with the yogurt banana mixture. Top with honey and cinnamon.

recipes.name: Tropical Yogurt Pops
recipes.description: Enjoy a tropical treat with these frozen yogurt pops! They are fun to make and have 1/4 cup of fruit per serving.
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango pieces, fresh or frozen
1/2 cup pineapple pieces, fresh, canned, or frozen
ice cube tray or small paper cups
steps: Place all ingredients into blender. Blend on high until smooth.
Pour into 8 ice cube squares (or 4 small paper cups) and place in cut paper straws or popsicle sticks. Freeze and enjoy!

recipes.name: Sweet and Sour Cabbage
recipes.description: This tangy cabbage dish requires no cooking. Chill for several hours and serve as a side dish for lunch or dinner.
ingredients: 1/2 medium head of cabbage (about 4 cups when chopped)
steps: Cut the cabbage in half and rinse it with water.
Chop the cabbage into very thin bit-sized slices.
In a large bowl, combine ingredients and mix well. Cover the bowl.
Chill in the fridge for several hours before serving.

recipes.name: Strawberry Kiwi Yogurt Pops
recipes.description: Cool off with frozen pops that are fun to make! Mix different yogurt and fruit combinations to find your favorite.
ingredients: ice cube tray or small paper cups
steps: Cut kiwi and strawberries into small pieces.
Add yogurt to chopped fruit and mix well to combine.
Divide into 8 ice cube squares (or 4 small paper cups).
Place in cut paper straws or popsicle sticks. Freeze and enjoy!

recipes.name: Chunky Garbanzo Bean Dip
recipes.description: Lemon pepper and chopped onion make this a zesty dip that you can use with vegetables or other foods.
steps: Drain and rinse the beans and mash in a small bowl with a fork or potato masher until most of the beans have been crushed.
If you have a food processor, you can use it for this step.
Stir in oil and onion along with lemon pepper and salt to taste.
The mixture will be chunky, not smooth.

recipes.name: Maple Sweet Potatoes
recipes.description: Sweet potatoes, maple syrup, orange juice, and yogurt are a winning combination in this easy dish that can be made in the microwave.
steps: Prick potato skins with a fork.
Microwave on high for 3 to 4 minute until soft and easily pierced with a knife.
Scoop out the pulp into a medium bowl.
Mash the pulp and stir in the yogurt, maple syrup, and orange juice.
Transfer to a microwave safe serving bowl and microwave for 1 to 2 minutes to heat through.

recipes.name: Salsa Pinto Beans
recipes.description: Spicy, savory beans make a great fiber-filled side dish.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil (or cooking oil of choice)
1 clove garlic, minced (or 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder)
2 cans (15 ounces each) low-sodium pinto beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until tender. Stir in the beans and salsa. Cook for 10 minutes.
Serve over rice, pasta, or baked potato.

recipes.name: Citrus Vegetables
recipes.description: Put a new twist on classic mixed vegetables with a splash of lime juice, some olive oil, and fresh oregano.
ingredients: 4 cups mixed vegetables (such as zucchini, corn, and tomatoes)
1/2 tablespoon olive oil (or cooking oil of choice)
steps: Slice vegetables and steam in a small amount of water.
Drain, and place in a bowl to cool. Mix lime juice with oil. Add oregano and combine.
Pour lime juice mixture over cool vegetables and mix well. Serve.

recipes.name: Mini Caprese Bites
recipes.description: These fun, bite-sized snacks are a great way to use basil and tomatoes from a SNAP-Ed garden. They can also help kids learn to like veggies.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil, or cooking oil of choice
steps: Slice string cheese into 4 equal parts.
On a toothpick, skewer one cherry tomato, 2 basil leaves, and 1 piece string cheese.
Drizzle finished kebabs evenly with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.

recipes.name: Tangy Jicama Slaw
recipes.description: Jicama provides a wonderful crunchy texture for this tasty and tangy slaw.
ingredients: 1 cup canned Mandarin oranges (in light syrup)
1 1/2 tablespoons lime juice (juice of one lime)
steps: Cut the jicama in half so you have a flat side for stability.
Peel the jicama using a small sharp knife.
Cut the jicama in small strips or grate it using a large hand grater.
Stir all the ingredients together in a bowl and enjoy.

recipes.name: Sweet and Savory Peanut Butter Dip
recipes.description: This creamy dip is a great after-school snack! In addition to celery, you can serve it with apples, carrots, jicama, or bell peppers.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon reduced sodium soy sauce (reduced sodium)
steps: Combine peanut butter, apple butter, milk, soy sauce, and lime juice in a small bowl.
Whisk together until very smooth.
Store tightly, sealed in refrigerator.
Serve with celery or other crunchy fruits and vegetables.

recipes.name: Parmesan Peas
recipes.description: Give (these) peas a chance! Try varying this recipe by using other types of cheese or adding different seasonings.
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons unsalted butter (or cooking oil of your choice)
2 cans of reduced-sodium peas, drained and rinsed (15 ounce cans or 16 ounces frozen peas)
steps: Heat butter in a medium skillet over medium heat.
Add peas and cook 2 to 3 minutes or until peas are heated through.
Add lemon juice and pepper and mix well.
Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and serve warm.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Pudding
recipes.description: No cooking required for this tasty pumpkin pudding. Kids can help prepare with supervision.
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin, 15 ounces (or 2 cups cooked mashed squash such as Hubbard)
2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice (or 1 teaspoon cinnamon, 1/2 teaspoon ginger, 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg and 1/4 teaspoon cloves)
steps: In a large bowl mix pumpkin, salt and pumpkin spice together.
Slowly stir in milk and mix well.
Add instant pudding mix and stir for 2 minutes until it thickens.
Refrigerate until serving time.

recipes.name: Chilled Blueberry Soup
recipes.description: This refreshing and beautiful quick, summer soup features a blend of blueberries, apple juice, and low-fat yogurt, and is garnished with fresh mint leaves.
steps: Rinse blueberries and set aside a few for garnishing.
Blend all ingredients in food processor or blender. Serve immediately.
Garnish with mint leaves and blueberries, if desired.

recipes.name: Frozen Banana Pops
recipes.description: Engage your kids in a fun activity by having them slice and dip ripe bananas in orange or lemon juice and place the bananas in the freezer for several hours to create this tasty snack or dessert.
ingredients: 1/8 cup orange juice or lemon juice (2 Tablespoons)
steps: Peel each banana and cut in half (width-wise).
Insert craft stick into bottom of each banana half.
Dip each banana half into juice.
Wrap in foil and freeze for two or more hours.

recipes.name: Hot Cornmeal Cereal
recipes.description: A hot, hearty, and savory breakfast cereal that the whole family will enjoy.
steps: Mix the cornmeal, salt, and cold water.
Pour into the boiling water, stirring occasionally.
Cook until thickened, stirring often.
Cover and cook over low heat about 15 minutes.
Serve hot with milk and sugar.

recipes.name: Rice Dessert
recipes.description: Easy, delicious, and full of fruit, Rice Dessert is a nice way to end a good meal.
ingredients: 1 cup crushed pineapple in juice (8 ounce can)
steps: Put aside 1/4 cup of drained pineapple.
Mix all other ingredients together in a medium-sized bowl. Serve in small dishes.
Top with the remaining crushed pineapple.

recipes.name: Citrus Salad
recipes.description: This recipe to can help make half your plate fruits and vegetables. Grapefruit sections are a great addition to fruit or green salads.
steps: Cut fruit into bite size pieces. Toss with lettuce and onion.
Mix remaining ingredients for dressing.
Drizzle over salad and toss just before serving.

recipes.name: Herbed Vegetables
recipes.description: Serve this savory side dish with your favorite entree. This recipe can be made in minutes!
ingredients: 2 cups vegetables (any combination of fresh, frozen, or canned)
1/2 teaspoon Italian herbs, basil, or rosemary (dried, crushed)
steps: If using canned (low-sodium) vegetables, drain, saving 2 tablespoons liquid.
Cook onion, herbs, and garlic in the margarine/ butter in a small saucepan until onion is tender.
Stir in the vegetables and liquid or add water as needed.
Cook and stir until heated through.

recipes.name: 3-Can Chili
recipes.description: With almost no cooking required to prepare this chili, just open cans of beans, corn, and tomatoes, and heat everything together in a pan!
ingredients: 1 can (15.5 ounces) low-sodium black beans, undrained (or pinto, kidney, or red beans)
1 can (15.2 ounces) reduced sodium corn, drained (or 10-oz package of frozen corn)
1 can (14.5 ounces) low-sodium crushed tomatoes, undrained
1 teaspoon chili powder (or more, to taste)
steps: Place the contents of all 3 cans into a pan. Add chili powder to taste. Stir to mix.
Continue to stir over medium heat until heated thoroughly. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.name: Whole Wheat Garlic Bread Sticks
recipes.description: These easy and delicious garlic bread sticks are a great side dish for our Chicken Spaghetti or as a snack.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil (or cooking oil of choice)
steps: Preheat oven to 300 degrees F. Spread each slice of bread with one teaspoon oil.
Sprinkle with garlic powder and Italian seasoning.
Cut each slice into 3 equal parts.
Bake in preheated oven for about 25 minutes or until crisp and lightly browned.

recipes.name: Batido (Smoothie)
recipes.description: This refreshing smoothie is a blend of papaya, banana, and yogurt and makes a satisfying part of breakfast or any time of day. Mix in frozen or fresh berries for a variety of flavors.
steps: Put all the ingredients in the blender. Put the lid on tightly.
Turn the blender to a medium setting and blend until the ice is chopped and the mixture is smooth, about 1 minute.
Serve right away or cover and refrigerate up to 4 hours.

recipes.name: Strawberry Yogurt Pops
recipes.description: Strawberries and yogurt are all you need for this healthy frozen pop! They're a great after school snack or sweet treat.
ingredients: ice cube tray or small paper cups
steps: Cut strawberries into small pieces.
Place strawberries and yogurt into blender and mix until smooth.
Pour into 8 ice cube squares (or 4 small paper cups) and place in cut paper straws or popsicle sticks. Freeze and enjoy!

recipes.name: Hummus
recipes.description: This classic garbanzo bean dip is easy to make and a versatile dish. Serve hummus with fresh raw vegetables, on a piece of whole wheat pita bread or tortilla, on crackers, or as a sandwich filling.
ingredients: 2 cups garbanzo beans, cooked (also known as chickpeas)
1 tablespoon sesame tahini [sesame paste] (or substitute peanut butter for a sweet taste)
steps: Mash the garbanzo beans until smooth (if you have a blender, put the beans and lemon juice into it and blend).
Add the garlic, lemon juice, tahini and oil. Mix well.

recipes.name: Basic Soup and Sauce Mix
recipes.description: This pantry staple can be used in casseroles, soups, dips, and many more dishes!
steps: Yield: Equal to about 3 cups dry or makes up to 9 cans equivalent cream soup. To use as a substitute for 1 can of cream soup: Storage: Store in closed plastic bag or air-tight container until ready to use. It does not have to be refrigerated.

recipes.name: Italian Bean Soup
recipes.description: Three beans combine with savory vegetables in a rich, tomato-based broth for this Italian Bean Soup. Served with a whole wheat roll, this recipe makes a satisfying and wholesome lunch or dinner.
ingredients: 1 can (15.5 ounces) great northern beans, low-sodium
1 can (15.5 ounces) red kidney beans, low-sodium
46 us fluid ounces tomato juice, low-sodium (or V-8 brand juice)
1 can (14.5 ounces) Italian style or stewed tomatoes, low-sodium
steps: In a large pot, combine all ingredients.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with Italian or French bread or whole-wheat rolls.

recipes.name: Salmon Spread
recipes.description: A zesty spread that is perfect as a snack. Serve with whole grain bread, crackers, or rice cakes.
ingredients: 4 green onion, chopped (or 1/4 cup onion, or onion powder to taste)
steps: Drain salmon and flake with a fork into a bowl. Mix in all other ingredients.
Serve on bread, crackers, or a rice cake.
Sprinkle chopped parsley to garnish.

recipes.name: 5 A Day Salad
recipes.description: This nutrient-packed salad uses ten different vegetables, and each serving is equal to five cups of vegetables!
ingredients: 2 cups chopped green peppers (or red, yellow, or orange peppers)
steps: Wash all of the vegetables and mix them together in a large mixing bowl.
Top this colorful meal with the nonfat or low-fat dressing of your choice.

recipes.name: Baked Chicken
recipes.description: Take the mystery out of baking chicken. A little garlic powder and pepper are all the added flavorings you need.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 °F. Put the chicken in a baking pan or casserole dish.
Sprinkle with garlic powder and pepper to taste. Bake for 1 hour.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Patties
recipes.description: Mashed sweet potatoes are coated in bread crumbs and lightly fried in a pan for an easy side dish. Enjoy with a fresh green salad, and whole grain toast, or brown rice.
steps: Wash the sweet potatoes.
Bake the sweet potatoes in a microwave until they are soft.
Remove the peels from the sweet potatoes.
Put the sweet potatoes in a medium bowl. Mash them with a fork.
Crush the breadcrumbs on a cutting board with a rolling pin or jar.
Put the crushed breadcrumbs in a small bowl.
Shape sweet potato into 6 small patties.
Roll each patty in the crushed crumbs.
Heat the oil in a medium frying pan on medium heat.
Brown each patty on both sides in the oil.

recipes.name: Hot 'N Spicy Seasoning
recipes.description: Turn up the heat, but not the sodium, with this powerful and flavorful seasoning blend!
steps: Mix all ingredients together. Store in airtight container.

recipes.name: Ambrosia
recipes.description: This dessert features fresh fruit, yogurt, and coconut, with a dash of marshmallows for fun. No cooking is required.
ingredients: 1 can (20 ounces) pineapple chunks in juice, drained
steps: Drain pineapple and oranges. Use juice as beverage.
Combine fruit with marshmallows and coconut. Fold in yogurt. Chill. Serve.

recipes.name: Bugs on a Log
recipes.description: Kids and adults can create their own combinations of the ingredients for a fun and healthy snack activity.
steps: Choose one "log" option and top with a spread. Sprinkle with a "bug."

recipes.name: Farmers Market Salsa
recipes.description: Lime, garlic, and fresh vegetables give this black bean and corn salsa a kick of flavor.
ingredients: 1 can (15 ounces) low-sodium black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Chill until serving time. Drain before serving.
Serve with low-fat baked tortilla chips or fresh vegetables.

recipes.name: Fruit Salsa
recipes.description: A salsa that is different from what you may usually have, this fruit recipe can be a great way to help older kids and teens learn safe knife skills in the kitchen.
steps: Combine fruits in a medium mixing bowl and add lemon juice.
Stir in sugar, nutmeg, and cinnamon. Mix well.
Refrigerate until serving time.

recipes.name: Corn and Cucumber Salad
recipes.description: Spices and red wine vinegar dress up the vegetables in this recipe. Enjoy as a side dish with your favorite entree.
steps: Combine ingredients and mix well. Serve cold.

recipes.name: Sanchico Tuna Salad
recipes.description: This tuna salad gets its creamy flavor from the avocado and a slight punch from the crushed red pepper.
ingredients: 1 can chunk light tuna (in water, 6.5 ounce can)
steps: Drain tuna.
Transfer to a mixing bowl and mix well with avocado for texture.
Add tomatoes, onion, lime juice, crushed red pepper, salt, and mango.

recipes.name: Orange Cow
recipes.description: This cold orange drink can be enjoyed for breakfast or at any time of the day.
steps: Place all ingredients in blender or food processor.
Secure lid and blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Purple Cow
recipes.description: Kids are going to love this purple treat, which is perfect for a hot summer day. They will never know that it is high in vitamin C!
steps: Place all ingredients in blender or food processor.
Secure lid and blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Caribbean Bean Salad
recipes.description: A refreshing and delicious salad that includes tomatoes, oranges, beans, onions, and lettuce.
ingredients: 1 cup canned black beans, low-sodium (drained and rinsed)
1 tablespoon olive oil (or cooking oil of choice)
steps: Toss all ingredients together in large salad bowl.
Serve immediately or refrigerate up to one hour.

recipes.name: Lite Italian Dressing
recipes.description: Making your own salad dressings is a simple way to add a fresh, homemade taste. Try this one today!
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder (or 1 fresh clove, minced)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a pint sized jar with tight fitting lid.
Shake vigorously to blend ingredients. Store refrigerated.

recipes.name: Grape Salsa
recipes.description: A fruit-packed, refreshing twist on salsa. Perfect for topping tacos or scooping up with tortilla chips.
ingredients: 1/2 cup Anaheim chili, fresh or canned (diced)
1 clove garlic (minced or 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and mix well. Let stand at least 1 hour.
Drain off excess liquid before serving.

recipes.name: Thousand Island Dressing
recipes.description: Try this sweet and tangy dressing on your favorite salad or as a dip for veggies.
ingredients: 3 sweet pickle relish packets (2/3 tablespoon packets each)
steps: Wash hands with soap and warm water. Mix ingredients together.
Chill and serve over vegetables or on a salad.

recipes.name: Fruit Kabobs with Yogurt Dip
recipes.description: Fruit kabobs make a colorful and fun snack that kids can help prepare.
ingredients: 2 kiwifruits, peeled and cut into quarters
steps: Place fruit chunks on bamboo skewers.
Place fruit kabobs on platter.
Place light strawberry yogurt in bowl.
Serve kabobs with yogurt on the side.

recipes.name: Cucumber Salad
recipes.description: This cucumber salad has a light and creamy dressing. Make it ahead of time and chill it in the refrigerator until you are ready to serve it.
steps: Peel and thinly slice cucumber.
Mix all other ingredients in the mixing bowl.
Add cucumber slices and stir until coated. Chill until serving.

recipes.name: French Salad Dressing
recipes.description: This sweet and tangy dressing can be used as a salad dressing or as a veggie dip.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil (or cooking oil of choice)
steps: Put all the ingredients in a jar or bottle with a lid. Put on the lid. Shake well.
Chill in the fridge for at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.name: Zesty Herb Salad Dressing
recipes.description: Vinegar, orange juice, and herbs combine to give this dressing a sweet and tangy flavor. Season to your taste.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil (or cooking oil of your choice)
steps: Put all the ingredients in a jar or bottle with a lid. Put on the lid. Shake well.
Chill in the fridge for at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.name: Hiding Rabbits
recipes.description: A cute and easy way to get kids excited about eating their veggies!
ingredients: 2 celery stalks (each piece cut in half lengthwise)
steps: Place one piece of celery in center of plate with the center facing up.
Use a butter knife to spread peanut butter on top edges.
Place second piece of celery on top, forming a log. Cut log in half.
Repeat steps 1-3 with remaining 2 pieces of celery.
Place cauliflower florets on ends of each log, securing with remaining peanut butter. Enjoy your Hiding Rabbits.

recipes.name: Chickpea Dip
recipes.description: Make your own delicious chickpea dip! Yogurt and paprika add a new dimension to this hummus recipe.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil (or cooking oil of choice)
1 can (15 ounces) chickpeas, low-sodium, drained (garbanzo beans)
steps: Put all ingredients into a food processor and blend until smooth.
Serve at room temperature with pita chips, crackers, carrots, or other dipping vegetables.

recipes.name: Salt-free All Purpose Blend
recipes.description: There are endless options for where you would want to add this seasoning blend -- rice, meat, fish, vegetables, and more! Try on your favorite dish to boost flavor but not salt.
steps: Mix all ingredients in a small bowl, using a spoon.
Place mix into a container that allows you to shake to dispense.

recipes.name: Salsa
recipes.description: This fresh tasting salsa is easy to whip up for your next get together.
ingredients: 2 cans (14.5 ounces) low-sodium diced tomatoes, drained
1 can (4.5 ounces) diced green chiles, drained
steps: In a large bowl, stir together all the ingredients until well mixed.
Cover and chill at least 4 hours.
Serve with Baked Tortilla Chips or raw vegetables.

recipes.name: Curry Vegetable Dip
recipes.description: Turn the heat up on this vegetable dip by using hot curry powder or use regular curry powder for a more mild taste.
steps: Mix ingredients in a bowl. Chill.
Serve with crisp raw vegetables pieces, such as celery, carrot, or summer squash sticks.

recipes.name: Dried Bananas
recipes.description: Looking for a healthy, crunchy snack? This recipe is super simple and can be made in bulk in advance.
ingredients: acidic fruit juice (lemon, lime, orange, pineapple) to reduce browning (optional)
steps: Slice bananas into 1/8 to 1/4-inch slices. (Optional) Dip banana slices into fruit juice to reduce browning.
Sprinkle with cinnamon or other flavorings if desired.
Dry until pieces bend like thick leather and no longer feel sticky.
Oven Instructions: Set oven to lowest temperature possible (175 to 200 °F). Use convection bake if available.
Arrange banana slices in a single layer on a wire rack or baking sheet.
A wire rack will help the banana dry faster.
A baking sheet takes longer and pieces need to be turned part way through drying. Drying takes 1 to 3 hours.
Dehydrator Instructions: Arrange banana slices in a single layer on dehydrator racks.
Set dehydrator to 135 °F. Drying takes 6 to 12 hours. 5. Cool.
Store in an airtight container or bag.

recipes.name: Easiest Banana Ice Cream
recipes.description: What should you do with over-ripe bananas? Don't toss them! Freeze them and then throw them in the blender to make this delicious and creamy frozen dessert.
steps: When bananas have become very ripe, peel and slice them into medium size round pieces.
Place on a plastic wrap covered baking sheet and put in freezer overnight.
Place frozen bananas in a food processor or blender with a small splash of milk (not over 1/4 cup total).
Pulse food processor or blender until bananas begin to break up. They will be tiny balls of bananas at this point.
Using a spoon or rubber spatula, scrape down the banana mixture.
Continue running the food processor until the mixture is smooth and creamy. This may take a few minutes.
The ice cream will look and tasted like soft serve ice cream when finished.
Serve in an ice cream cone or in a small bowl with a small ribbon of chocolate syrup on top (optional).

recipes.name: Mango Shake
recipes.description: Have a fruity and frosty treat! Banana, mango, and milk are blended together to make this delicious drink.
ingredients: 1 fresh pitted mango (or 4 Tablespoons of frozen mango juice)
steps: Put all ingredients into a blender. Blend until foamy. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Honey Mustard Dressing
recipes.description: Make your favorite salad dressing at home, in minutes!
steps: Put all the ingredients in a jar or bottle with a lid. Put on the lid. Shake well.
Chill in the fridge for at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.name: Sweet and Sour Salad Dressing
recipes.description: Vegetable oil is used to make this sweet and sour salad dressing.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil (or cooking oil of choice)
steps: Mix all ingredients and stir or shake well.
Chill in the fridge for at least 1 hour before serving.
Store in the fridge in a bottle or container.

recipes.name: Pico de Gallo
recipes.description: A fantastic recipe to try when your garden or market is overflowing with fresh, flavorful tomatoes!
steps: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl.
Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate for up to 3 days.

recipes.name: Cooked Beans
recipes.description: A good, basic instructional recipe for cooking dry beans. Cooked beans are a great way to get more iron and fiber and can be eaten alone or added to salads and side dishes.
steps: Sort : Before soaking beans, pick them over and remove any damaged beans, small stones or dirt.
Soak : Most beans will rehydrate to triple their dry size, so be sure to start with a large enough pot.
Choose one of the methods to soak your beans.
Cook : Drain soaking water and rinse beans. Cover beans with fresh water.
Simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until tender.
Soaking Methods: Hot Soak: Hot soaking helps reduce intestinal gas.
For each pound (2 cups) of dry beans, add 10 cups hot water; heat to boiling and let boil 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove from heat, cover and set aside for up to 4 hours.
Quick Soak: For each pound (2 cups) of dry beans, add 10 cups hot water; heat to boiling and let boil 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove from heat, cover and set aside for at least one hour.
Overnight Soak: For each pound (2 cups) of dry beans, add 10 cups cold water and let soak overnight, or at least 8 hours.

recipes.name: Oven-Fried Yucca
recipes.description: Yucca is a starchy vegetable with a taste and texture similar to while potatoes. Enjoy this yucca side dish with one of your favorite protein- or vegetable-based entrees.
ingredients: 1 pound yucca (cassava) peeled and cut into 3-inch sections (or 1 pound peeled frozen yucca)
1 spray non-stick cooking spray, as needed
steps: In a large pot, combine the yucca with enough cold water to cover it by 1 inch.
Bring the water to a boil and slowly simmer the yucca for 20 to 30 minutes, or until it is tender.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Transfer the yucca with a slotted spoon to a cutting board.
Let it cool and cut it lengthwise into 3/4-inch wide wedges, discarding the thin woody core.
Spray cookie sheet with the nonstick cooking oil spray.
Spread yucca wedges on cookie sheet and spray wedges with cooking oil spray.
Cover with foil paper and bake for 8 minutes.
Uncover and return to oven to bake for an additional 7 minutes.

recipes.name: Peach Sorbet
recipes.description: Try this refreshing peach sorbet or create your own flavor combination!
ingredients: 2 cans sliced peaches in 100% juice (15-ounce cans)
steps: Collect all ingredients and freeze cans before starting to prepare the recipe.
Place cans of fruit in freezer for at least 3 hours. Take out when fully frozen.
Run frozen cans briefly under hot water, or let them sit on counter for 30 minutes to loosen contents.
Remove fruit from the cans, and use a sharp knife to cut it into small pieces.
If using a banana, peel, and cut into slices. Banana does not need to be frozen.
Place frozen, chopped fruit (and banana, if using) in the blender, and blend until creamy. Serve immediately.
Freeze any leftovers in a freezer-safe container or sealable plastic freezer bags. It is ok to freeze these cans overnight. They will not explode.

recipes.name: Dutch Apple Yogurt Dessert
recipes.description: This treat blends cool, tangy yogurt with the sweetness of apple sauce and spices for a smooth and satisfying dessert or snack!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon nuts (as topping or crunchy cereal)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl.
Cover and refrigerate until chilled.
Eat and enjoy as a snack or as a dessert.

recipes.name: Cucumber Salad with Tomatoes
recipes.description: Fresh tomatoes and cucumbers make this couscous salad a summer time treat.
steps: Toss together the cucumbers, tomatoes, onions, couscous (or rice), dill, and salad dressing. Chill for 1 hour. Serve.

recipes.name: Chili and Spice Seasoning
recipes.description: A combination of zesty herbs and spices add flavor without adding salt. Make this seasoning mix ahead of time and keep it in your pantry to use in soups, stews, sauces, casseroles, and more! 1 serving = 1 Tablespoon
steps: Mix together all ingredients. Store in airtight container.

recipes.name: Herbed Dip
recipes.description: A creamy, savory, dip that can be prepared in under 5 minutes! Enjoy!
steps: Place all the ingredients in a blender.
Blend all the ingredients thoroughly.
Pour the mixture into a clean container. Cover and chill.

recipes.name: Sunshine Salad
recipes.description: Oranges help to brighten up this tasty veggie salad. It is quick and easy to make. Top it off with your favorite vinaigrette.
ingredients: 5 cups spinach leaves, packed, washed, and dried well
2 medium oranges, peeled and chopped into bite-sized pieces
1/3 cup "lite" vinaigrette dressing (around 15 calories per tablespoon or less)
steps: Toss all ingredients together in a large bowl. Add dressing and toss again. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Corn and Green Chili Salad
recipes.description: Cilantro, lime juice, and green onions add a delightful taste to this corn side dish. Try using fresh corn when it is in season.
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon vegetable oil (or cooking oil of choice)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Mix well.

recipes.name: Spinach, Tomatoes, and Corn
recipes.description: Canned veggies make this dish easy to prepare at any time of the year! No fresh veggies necessary.
steps: Place all ingredients in a large saucepan. Cover.
Heat thoroughly over medium-high heat, about 10 minutes. Add seasonings to taste.

recipes.name: Corn Salad with Fat-free Ranch Dressing
recipes.description: This corn salad is a great side dish that's easy to make in advance and serve when needed.
ingredients: 2 cups whole kernel corn, fresh or frozen (cooked and drained)
steps: In bowl, combine vegetables. Stir in dressing.
Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.name: Heavenly Deviled Eggs
recipes.description: Versatile and easy to prepare, these deviled eggs are great as an appetizer, side dish, or snack.
steps: Put eggs into a saucepan. Cover with cold water.
Bring eggs to a simmer (small bubbles) and cook for 12 minutes.
Remove from the heat and drain.
Crack eggs under cold water and allow to cool. Remove shells.
Split eggs in half lengthwise and remove yolks.
Put yolks, dressing and mustard into a small zipper-lock plastic bag to mix.
Cut a small hole in a lower corner of the bag.
Squeeze mixture into egg white halves. Garnish as desired.

recipes.name: Low Calorie Dressing
recipes.description: This dressing is low in calories but not flavor. Dress up any salad with this tasty dressing.
steps: Combine all ingredients. Whisk or stir together. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.name: Zesty Citrus Coleslaw
recipes.description: This coleslaw is big on flavor with nuts, Mandarin oranges, and soy sauce!
ingredients: 4 cups shredded cabbage (or 16 ounce bag of coleslaw mix)
steps: Mix together the coleslaw mix, Mandarin oranges, and peanuts (if using) in a large bowl.
Stir in the Italian salad dressing and soy sauce.

recipes.name: Fresh Salsa
recipes.description: Fresh tomatoes with jalapeno peppers, cilantro, onions, and lime make this dish a light and easy summer time treat. Serve it with chicken and rice for a complete meal.
ingredients: 3 jalapeno chiles, finely chopped, seeded if desired
steps: In a medium bowl, mix all ingredients.
Serve or store salsa in refrigerator for up to three days in a covered plastic or glass container.

recipes.name: Apple Salad
recipes.description: For this delectable and simple seasonal salad, combine diced apples and celery with raisins and nuts. Add dressing and enjoy!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lite mayonnaise-type dressing (or light mayonnaise)
steps: Mix orange juice with salad dressing or mayonnaise.
Toss apples, celery, raisins and nuts with the dressing mixture.

recipes.name: Melon and Mint
recipes.description: In the mood for a refreshing snack? The combination of mint and lime on this fruit makes it a refreshing treat.
steps: Blend lime juice, mint leaves, and brown sugar together in a small food processor. Place melon cubes in a bowl.
Drizzle dressing over melon and toss gently.

recipes.name: Lemonade
recipes.description: A fresh, single serving of lemonade that is perfect for a hot summer day. Only one lemon is needed for this recipe. Enjoy!
steps: Cut lemon in half crosswise. Place lemon half on juicer.
Push and twist to squeeze out the juice. Pour juice into glass. Add about 3/4 cup water.
Add sugar, stirring to mix ingredients.
Create-a-Flavor Changes Squeeze one-half each lemon and lime.
Squeeze one-half each lemon and orange.
Add 1/4 cup apple juice concentrate and leave out the sugar.
Use 1/4 cup seltzer water and 1/2 cup water.

recipes.name: Avocado and Corn Salsa
recipes.description: Avocado and corn are given a flavor boost by fresh cilantro and lime. Serve this salsa with our Baked Chicken for an easy weekday meal.
steps: Toss avocado, corn, tomatoes, cilantro, lime juice, and salt in a medium bowl.
Chill one hour and then serve.

recipes.name: Cherry, Melon, & Grape Salad
recipes.description: A delicious fruit salad with an added twist of cherries and coconut flakes. You will feel like you are in a tropical paradise eating this salad.
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet cherries, pitted and cut in half
1 cup seedless green grapes, cut in half
steps: In a large bowl, mix together the cut fruit.
Pour orange juice over fruit and stir in coconut, if desired.

recipes.name: Tartar Sauce
recipes.description: A cost-effective alternative to store-bought tartar sauce. Use this sauce with your favorite seafood at home and it will not disappoint.
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat plain yogurt (or low-fat sour cream)
1 tablespoon onion, minced (or 2 teaspoons dried minced onion)
1 teaspoon dried parsley (or 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley)
steps: In a small bowl, combine all the ingredients.
Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate until used.

recipes.name: Italian Pasta Salad
recipes.description: Fresh and crunchy broccoli, carrot, bell pepper, and green onion, make this easy and delicious pasta salad burst with flavor! This pasta salad would be an excellent side dish to grilled meat, fish, or tofu.
ingredients: 1/2 cup Italian salad dressing, light or reduced fat (can use more if desired)
steps: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl.
Refrigerate for about 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Yogurt Fruit Salad
recipes.description: Yogurt pulls all the flavors together in this splendid fruit salad! Use seasonal fruit if you have it on hand.
steps: Mix yogurt, cinnamon, and orange juice in a medium bowl.
Wash and chop the fruit and add to the yogurt mixture. Stir and serve.

recipes.name: Creamy Italian Herb Dressing
recipes.description: Serve this creamy dressing over salads or use as a dip for your favorite veggies.
steps: In a small bowl, combine all the above ingredients.
Refrigerate in a covered container for at least an hour. Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Summer Breeze Smoothie
