recipes.description: A delicious smoothie makes the perfect summer snack or dessert.
ingredients: 1 cup crushed pineapple, canned in juice
steps: Place all ingredients in blender and purée until smooth. Serve in frosted glass.

recipes.name: Chili Popcorn
recipes.description: Make your own savory popcorn featuring chili and garlic flavors. Popcorn is one way to add whole grains and fiber into your diet.
steps: Mix popcorn and margarine in a bowl.
Mix seasonings thoroughly and sprinkle over popcorn. Mix well.
Serve immediately and enjoy with family and friends.

recipes.name: Applesauce
recipes.description: Homemade applesauce, an easy treat to make, is a wonderful side dish or dessert option.
steps: Wash and then cut apples in quarters. Apples can be peeled, but fiber will be decreased.
Combine apples and water in saucepan. Heat to boiling.
Turn heat to low as soon as the water is boiling.
Simmer over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes or until apples are tender.
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Stir in sugar and heat until sugar is dissolved.

recipes.name: Fruit Salad
recipes.description: This semi-homemade recipe mixes canned fruit cocktail with fresh fruit and yogurt for a quick and tasty fruit salad.
ingredients: 1 (8 ounce) container of yogurt, low-fat piña colada
steps: Mix fruit in a large bowl. Add yogurt and mix well.
Chill in refrigerator before serving.

recipes.name: Flavored Water
recipes.description: Try this refreshing flavor combination of watermelon and lime or create your own!
ingredients: 8 cups cold water (or less, depending on the amount of fruit added)
steps: Wash all produce. Slice limes.
Cut watermelon into 1-inch cubes.
Add lime and watermelon, plus enough cold water to a fill a 2-quart pitcher.
Chill overnight in the refrigerator for the most flavor, and store in the refrigerator until ready to drink.
The fruit will stay fresh in the water for up to 48 hours after being prepared.
After you drink the water, you can eat the fruit or blend it into a smoothie!

recipes.name: Eating Smart Seasoning Mix
recipes.description: Keep this seasoning mix on hand and use it whenever you want to boost flavor without adding salt.
steps: Combine all ingredients. Store in airtight container. Use in recipes as indicated.

recipes.name: Easy Baked Acorn Squash
recipes.description: This sweet and nutty squash pairs well with meats and other main dishes.
ingredients: 4 tablespoons maple syrup or honey (can replace with 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper per squash half for a savory flavor)
steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F. Cut acorn squash in half and scoop out seeds.
Fill a baking pan with about 1/2 inch of water.
Place the squash in the pan, flesh side up.
If they are lopsided, slice the underside horizontally so the bottom sits flat on the pan.
Add 1 tablespoon maple syrup or honey (or ground pepper if you prefer a savory flavor) to each half and spread evenly across the flesh.
Bake for about 1 hour, or until flesh is tender.
Serve as a side with meat or another main dish.

recipes.name: Mango Salsa
recipes.description: The sweetness of fresh mango combined with savory pepper and onion and the zest of lime give this salsa a balance of flavors that are refreshing and crisp. Serve this appetizer with baked tortilla chips or whole grain crackers for a tasty snack.
steps: Peel and chop the mango, be sure to remove the seed.
Cut the pepper and onion into small pieces.
Mix all the ingredients together.

recipes.name: Chili Bean Dip
recipes.description: This dip goes great with baked tortilla chips or raw vegetables at a party. You can experiment with the spices to get new flavors.
ingredients: 1 can (15.5 ounces) pinto beans, low-sodium (or 2 cups cooked dried beans)
steps: Mash beans in a bowl.
Add onion and chili powder and shredded cheese.
Serve warm or cold with raw vegetables or tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Green Bean Sauté
recipes.description: Jazz up green beans with mushrooms, onions, and garlic in a quick and easy vegetable side dish.
ingredients: 1 can green beans, low sodium (14.5 ounce, drained, cut)
steps: Spray a skillet with non-stick cooking spray.
Sauté onions, mushrooms, and garlic.
Add green beans and heat thoroughly.

recipes.name: Kale Chips
recipes.description: A crunchy chip that you can customize to your liking! Make sure kale is washed and thoroughly dried to ensure kale chips are crispy and not soggy.
ingredients: 1 cup kale (or chard, spinach, or collards)
1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil (or oil of your choice)
steps: Preheat oven to 300 °F. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper (optional). Wash and dry kale.
With a knife or kitchen scissors, carefully remove the leaves from the thick stems.
Tear into bite-sized pieces and place kale pieces on cookie sheet.
Drizzle oil over kale and then sprinkle with seasonings of choice.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until kale is crisp and edges are brown but not burned.

recipes.name: Mango Salsa
recipes.description: This sweet and tangy salsa pairs perfectly with grilled or baked fish or chicken. The recipe doubles easily if making for a crowd.
ingredients: 1 mango, peeled, pitted, and diced (or 1 cup thawed frozen chunks)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Serve with baked tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Crispy Oven Baked Fries
recipes.description: Use your favorite spices to season these oven baked French fries. Endless possibilities with your favorite seasoning blends.
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, cut into strips (great with sweet potatoes!)
2 tablespoons vegetable oil (or cooking oil of choice)
steps: Preheat oven to 450 °F. Lightly oil a 9x13 inch pan. Wash and cut potatoes. Pat dry on towels.
Spread strips of potatoes in one layer in pan.
Distribute remaining oil evenly over potatoes.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes until potatoes are golden brown and tender. Turn frequently. Season to taste.

recipes.name: Low Fat Creamy Dressing
recipes.description: A cool and tangy dressing or dip that’s perfect for your next salad or veggie tray.
steps: Mix and stir all ingredients in small container.
Store covered in refrigerator and use within 1 week.

recipes.name: Carrot Raisin Salad
recipes.description: This easy and healthy side salad has a sweet and tangy flavor. Make it ahead of time and serve it chilled.
steps: In a medium bowl, thoroughly mix carrots, raisins, sugar, and lemon juice. Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Vegetable Dipping Sauce
recipes.description: Honey and brown mustard are the secret ingredients in this dip, the perfect compliment for raw veggies. Whip this up today, and start snacking.
steps: Mix together all ingredients in a bowl.
Serve with your favorite vegetables.

recipes.name: Pineapple Orange Frozen Yogurt
recipes.description: A fruity and tropical treat to keep you cool during the dog days of summer.
ingredients: 1 cup pineapple chunks, fresh or canned
steps: Place yogurt and pineapple in large plastic bag and flatten. Freeze overnight.
Combine yogurt, pineapple, and juice in food processor or blender and blend until smooth.
Serve immediately or place back in the freezer to harden until ready to serve, up to 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Stir before serving.

recipes.name: Quick and Easy Bean Dip
recipes.description: Beans make delicious dips for delectable snacks and side dishes.
ingredients: 1/3 cup beans, low-sodium canned or cooked (pinto beans work great)
steps: Place beans in a small, resealable plastic bag.
Squeeze out extra air and seal. Mash beans with fingers. Add yogurt and salsa.
Seal bag and mix with fingers.
Open bag or cut off corner of bag and squeeze out dip.

recipes.name: Baked Tortilla Chips
recipes.description: Use this recipe to make your own whole wheat flour or corn flour tortilla chips.
steps: Preheat oven or toaster oven to 400 °F. Lightly grease a baking sheet with the cooking spray.
Cut tortillas into 8 sections (as if you were cutting a pizza) and place on baking sheet.
Spray tops of tortilla sections with cooking spray and lightly salt, if desired.
Bake for 10 minutes, until crisp and light brown, watching closely so the chips don't burn.

recipes.name: Shake-A-Pudding
recipes.description: A quick and easy dessert that kids will love making. Experiment with different flavors of pudding and fruit combinations.
ingredients: 1 carton (3.4 ounces) instant vanilla pudding mix
2 bananas, peeled and sliced (or other sliced fruit)
steps: Place 2 cups of milk in a quart jar with tight-fitting lid.
Add one small package of instant vanilla pudding mix to the jar; screw lid on jar.
Shake until mixture is smooth.
Place pieces of fruit in a serving bowl or paper cups.
Pour pudding over fruit and chill.

recipes.name: Fruit Yogurt Pops
recipes.description: These pops are a fun warm-weather treat that needs only two ingredients. With no cooking, cutting, or special equipment required, kids can learn to make these by themselves.
ingredients: 1 low fat yogurt, fruit flavored (8 ounces)
steps: Combine ingredients. Pour into 3 ounce paper cups.
Freeze about 30 minutes; then stick a wooden popsicle/ craft stick in the center of each cup. Freeze overnight until firm.
To eat pops, peel off paper cups.
For variety, try other fruit flavored yogurts and frozen fruit or fruit juice concentrates.

recipes.name: Pear in Orange Sauce
recipes.description: Sweet and simple, this warm and cozy dessert is the perfect end to a fall or winter meal.
steps: Peel the pears and cook in a double boiler for 15 minutes.
Mix sugar and orange juice and cook over low flame for 5 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes.
Place steamed pears on individual plates.
Pour 1/4 of the juice mixture over each and serve.

recipes.name: Drop Biscuits (from Better Baking Mix)
recipes.description: Using our Better Baking Mix and getting rid of the rolling and cutting steps means you can enjoy the goodness of homemade biscuits even when you're short on time. See the notes section for fun ways to vary this recipe.
steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F. Lightly grease baking sheet.
Add oil and water to the dry mix.
Stir just until all ingredients are wet.
Drop spoonsful 4 inches apart on baking sheet.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until lightly browned.

recipes.name: Lemon Spinach
recipes.description: This tangy spinach side dish can be prepared in a flash! Lemon juice adds extra flavor to this dish. Enjoy as a side to your favorite entree!
steps: Wash the spinach. Trim off the stems.
Put the spinach, black pepper, and lemon juice in a pan. Cook over medium heat.
Let the spinach boil for about 3 minutes, until just tender.

recipes.name: Strawberry S'Mores
recipes.description: No campfire required for these fruity graham cracker snacks!
steps: Rinse the strawberries in water. Slice the strawberries.
Add the yogurt and strawberries to 1/2 of graham cracker.
Top with the other 1/2 of graham cracker. Enjoy immediately.

recipes.name: Sweet and Sour Dressing
recipes.description: Only three ingredients in this fast and easy dressing. Served chilled over your favorite salad.
steps: In a small saucepan, combine sugar and cornstarch. Stir in vinegar.
Cook over medium heat until slightly thickened and clear. Chill before serving. Store refrigerated.

recipes.name: Peach Sauce
recipes.description: This simple peach sauce recipe is the perfect complement to your favorite dishes. Sweet peaches and aromatic cinnamon enhance savory dishes when topped on grilled chicken, or add extra sweetness and fruit to waffles, pancakes, and yogurt.
ingredients: 2 15-ounce cans of peaches, juice packed (with liquid)
steps: Drain peaches and reserve liquid.
Pour peaches into a medium saucepan with cinnamon.
Cook on low to medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring every few minutes.
Mash to desired consistency with either a potato masher or wooden spoon.
Add reserved peach liquid as needed.

recipes.name: Berry Good Dessert
recipes.description: Berries and fruit juice give this simple gelatin dessert all the sweetness it needs.
steps: Wash and slice the berries and then place in a shallow dish (9x9 inch brownie pan works well).
Combine gelatin and grape juice in a small pan and warm over low heat until the gelatin dissolves (about 5 minutes).
Pour gelatin and grape juice over berries and refrigerate until firm (about 1 hour).

recipes.name: Quick Black Bean Salad
recipes.description: This simple corn and bean salad can be made in minutes. Enjoy it on top of eggs, on whole grain tortilla, or on pita chips.
steps: Leave frozen corn in the fridge overnight to defrost.
If you forget to do this ahead of time, defrost it in the microwave.
Drain and rinse the black beans.
Combine all ingredients together and serve as a side dish.

recipes.name: Creamy Dill Dip
recipes.description: There is no cooking required for this dish, and kids can pick their favorite veggies to go along with the creamy dip.
steps: Put the sour cream, yogurt, and dill in a medium bowl. Stir together.
Store the dip in a covered container if you don’t plan to eat it right away.
Keep the dip in the fridge until you serve it.

recipes.name: Eagle Nest
recipes.description: Kids can enjoy making this healthy, fun, and easy after-school snack using peaches, cottage cheese, and raisins.
ingredients: 2 canned peach halves, packed in juice
steps: Place one peach half, cut side up, in center of plate for nest.
Place 1 tablespoon of cottage cheese in center of nest.
Place raisins on cottage cheese to make eggs. Enjoy your Eagle Nest.

recipes.name: Homemade Cranberry Sauce
recipes.description: A tangy and flavorful cranberry sauce that can be prepared in a flash!
ingredients: 3 cups fresh cranberries (12 ounces, can also use frozen)
steps: Peel orange and remove seeds.
Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until mixed well.
Heat up and serve over turkey.
For thicker sauce to do not blend just heat and serve.

recipes.name: Fruit Juice Slush
recipes.description: Blending your favorite fruit juice concentrate with ice and water will give you a quick and refreshing drink on a warm day.
steps: In a blender, place juice concentrate, water, and half of ice.
To prevent spillage, do not pass the top line of the blender.
Blend while gradually adding remaining ice. Serve.

recipes.name: Yogurt Pops
recipes.description: A quick, easy, and delicious frozen dessert made with your favorite fruit juice and yogurt.
steps: Put the yogurt and juice in a bowl. Stir together well. Pour the mix into paper cups.
Stick a popsicle stick in the center of the mix in the cup.
Place the yogurt pops in the freezer until they turn solid.

recipes.name: Basic Steamed Collards
recipes.description: Making this side dish is a simple way to add leafy greens to your meal.
steps: Wash and cut 5 large collard leaves, removing the thick stems.
Place greens in a pot with about 1 inch of water, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil.
After water boils, reduce to low heat and steam for about 3-5 minutes.
Add salt and pepper, to taste.

recipes.name: Turtle Apple
recipes.description: This simple and fun snack is created using only fresh apples and canned oranges.
steps: Wash apple. Cut in half (see notes).
Place apple half in center of small plate.
Put mandarin oranges next to apple for arms, legs, and head. Enjoy your Turtle Apple.

recipes.name: Curry Dip
recipes.description: Curry powder adds lots of flavor to this vegetable dip. Serve it with veggies or whole wheat pita for a satisfying snack.
steps: Mix the sour cream, yogurt, and curry powder.
Store the dip in a covered container if you don’t plan to eat it right away.
Keep the dip in the refrigerator until you serve it.

recipes.name: South of the Border Dip
recipes.description: This quick dip can be prepared in under 1 minute, making it perfect for last-minute gatherings.
steps: Mix the sour cream, yogurt, and salsa.
Store the dip in a covered container if you don’t plan to eat it right away.
Keep the dip in the fridge until you serve it.

recipes.name: Fruit Snake
recipes.description: Make the youngest members of your family happy with this adorable snack. It's perfect for a mid-morning or afterschool snack.
steps: Peel banana and use butter knife to cut banana in half lengthwise.
Place 2 banana halves on small plate end to end, in an "s" shape.
Add raisins to the top of banana as eyes. Enjoy your Fruit Snake.
